name: unify
description: Manage your Unify business from Claude: bookings, availability, resources, reports, inventory, invoices and AI planner approvals.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Unify SME booking platform (https://se-3090-se-002.vercel.app). Sign in with your Unify business account (Admin, Manager or Staff) and ask Claude to find free slots, book, reschedule or cancel appointments, check in guests, read your clinic/restaurant/gym/school/excursion dashboards, review revenue and no-shows, check low stock, look up invoices, and approve or reject AI planner workflows. Times are shown in your business's time zone.

tools.name: unify_whoami
tools.description: Shows the signed-in Unify user (name, role, tenant/business id, branch), the business profile (name, business type, sub-type), the API being used, and the time zone this connector uses.

tools.name: unify_list_branches
tools.description: Lists the business's branches (locations).

tools.name: unify_list_staff
tools.description: Lists staff and manager accounts of the business (Admin/Manager only).

tools.name: unify_search_customers
tools.description: Finds customers of this business by name, email or phone.

tools.name: unify_list_public_businesses
tools.description: Lists the public directory of businesses on the Unify platform (what customers see in the app's 'Find a business' screen).

tools.name: unify_list_resources
tools.description: Lists bookable resources (doctors, tables, trainers, tutors, boats, rooms, vehicles, equipment...).

tools.name: unify_get_resource
tools.description: Gets one resource with its weekly working schedule and schedule exceptions (holidays, leave, closures).

tools.name: unify_find_available_slots
tools.description: Finds open time slots on a given day.

tools.name: unify_get_booked_ranges
tools.description: Returns the periods a resource is already booked between two dates.

tools.name: unify_create_resource
tools.description: Adds a bookable resource (boat, room, vehicle, staff member, table...) to the business (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_update_resource
tools.description: Changes a resource's details or status (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_delete_resource
tools.description: Deletes a resource so it no longer appears anywhere (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_list_booking_types
tools.description: Lists the services/products that can be booked (e.g.

tools.name: unify_create_booking_type
tools.description: Adds a service customers can book, such as a tour or treatment (Admin/Manager), with duration, booking unit and per-person prices.

tools.name: unify_update_booking_type
tools.description: Changes a service's details, prices or status (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_delete_booking_type
tools.description: Archives a service so it can no longer be booked (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_list_bookings
tools.description: Lists bookings/reservations with filters.

tools.name: unify_get_booking
tools.description: Gets one booking, optionally with its full history timeline (who created, rescheduled, checked in...).

tools.name: unify_get_my_schedule
tools.description: The signed-in staff member's own bookings for a day (Admin/Manager/Staff).

tools.name: unify_find_booking_conflicts
tools.description: Reports overlapping bookings on the same resource (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_create_booking
tools.description: Creates a booking for a resource and booking type.

tools.name: unify_reschedule_booking
tools.description: Moves a booking to a new time.

tools.name: unify_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking.

tools.name: unify_update_booking_status
tools.description: Sets a booking's status: Confirmed (approve), Rejected, CheckedIn, InProgress, Completed, NoShow...

tools.name: unify_check_in_booking
tools.description: Checks a customer in for their booking (same as scanning their QR code).

tools.name: unify_send_booking_reminder
tools.description: Sends the customer a reminder for an upcoming booking.

tools.name: unify_get_dashboard
tools.description: Reads a business-type operations dashboard.

tools.name: unify_get_revenue_report
tools.description: Revenue for a period (optionally one branch).

tools.name: unify_get_booking_stats
tools.description: No-show statistics and revenue per time slot for a period (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_list_inventory
tools.description: Lists stock items (with quantities and reorder levels).

tools.name: unify_list_invoices
tools.description: Lists invoices with filters (status e.g.

tools.name: unify_get_invoice
tools.description: Gets one invoice with its line items and payments.

tools.name: unify_list_notifications
tools.description: The signed-in user's in-app notifications (new bookings, cancellations, approvals...), with unread count.

tools.name: unify_mark_notification_read
tools.description: Marks one notification as read.

tools.name: unify_list_ai_workflows
tools.description: Lists Unify's AI agent workflows (scheduling plans, find-and-book proposals) awaiting review or already handled.

tools.name: unify_get_ai_workflow
tools.description: Gets one AI workflow with its objective, planned steps and validation results.

tools.name: unify_approve_ai_workflow
tools.description: Approves a pending AI planner workflow (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_reject_ai_workflow
tools.description: Rejects a pending AI planner workflow with a reason (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_apply_ai_workflow
tools.description: Carries out an approved AI planner workflow, creating the bookings in its plan (Admin/Manager).

tools.name: unify_plan_schedule_with_ai
tools.description: Asks Unify's own AI planner to propose a batch of bookings (e.g.

tools.name: unify_ask_workspace_assistant
tools.description: Sends a question to the built-in Unify workspace assistant (the chat panel in the web app) and returns its answer.

tools.name: unify_api_get
tools.description: Read-only GET request to the Unify REST API (endpoint reference: https://sme-backend-lxsp.onrender.com/swagger), for data the other tools don't cover: equipment, departures, sightings, subscriptions, purchase orders, suppliers, dynamic forms, school reports and so on.

prompts.name: daily_briefing
prompts.description: Summarise today's bookings, alerts, conflicts and pending approvals.
prompts.text: Give me a briefing for my Unify business for ${arguments.date}.

prompts.name: book_appointment
prompts.description: Find a free slot and book it for a customer, confirming before booking.

email.title: Unify email
email.description: The email you sign in to Unify with (Admin, Manager or Staff account).

password.title: Unify password
password.description: Stored in your system keychain and only sent to the Unify API.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Unify API base URL. Leave the default unless you run your own backend.

timezone.title: Business time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone used to read and show times, e.g. Asia/Colombo.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow viewing - hides every tool that creates, changes or cancels anything.
